notes: Golds frozen BEFORE the first pilot run. Relevant sets are utility judgments from goal text (method-agnostic); they must not be tuned to any method's output.
No external adopted retrieval tool exists: docs/phase0-adopt-vs-build.md is dependency-only with an in-house rule. Comparison is B0/B1 only.
Fixture sources need not compile: the pilot is syntactic (regex import scan + word occurrences). Utility golds still judge semantic relevance.
Pilot = Phase3SemanticGraphPilot.referencesFor(seed) from src/core/codeintel/Phase3SemanticGraph.ts (method M1, single-query, plan-literal).

method.M1_pilot: seed symbol + enclosing index symbols of referencesFor(seed). Enclosing = smallest-span index symbol with same file and line in [line,endLine]; refs on import/comment/top-level lines with no enclosing symbol contribute nothing but are counted as unenclosed refs.
method.B0_keywords: goal tokens (lowercase, split on [^a-z0-9]+) minus STOPWORDS; a file matches if its content contains ANY keyword as a case-insensitive substring (union/OR). Result = all index symbols of matched files. Union is preregistered because a recall baseline must be generous; intersection would be a precision rule.
method.B1_closure: seed file + depth-1 both-direction import closure from an INDEPENDENT regex scan (no pilot code reuse): files that import the seed file plus files the seed file imports (import and export-from forms, relative specifiers resolved with .ts/.tsx/.js//index.ts probes). Result = all index symbols of those files.
method.metrics: Per-task exact-match set precision/recall vs relevant. PRIMARY: macro-average (mean of per-task P/R). Secondary: micro (global TP/FP/FN). Gate bars from docs/GATES.md, measured never changed: macro precision >= 0.95; macro recall >= B1 macro recall AND > B0 macro recall.
